evidence: Statically inferred original request lifecycle, conditional controller checks and independent native browser acceptance. No new original audio timeline, waveform or complete ending-timing capture.

environment.audio: Current sound-enabled flag gates source requests. Sound001 uses the persistent selected device. Completion does not advance ending phases. Muting resets through the existing browser adapter; unmuting within a phase does not restart music.
environment.choice: Replay returns an explicit choice event to the application. Yes initializes difficulty directly, bypassing the browser title and its music. Main reset0 occurs after difficulty confirmation; No receives the replay reset0 and main reset0 before credits.
environment.unchanged: Existing picture/credits waits, input polling, redraw and bank-animation adapters are retained. Original global-key alignment, first-poll/Fire timing, picture reveals and bank animation remain incomplete or unverified.

scenario.inputs: Authored events in tests/ending-audio.test.js; real browser map journeys, Fire, arrows and sound settings in tests/browser/ending-audio.spec.js. No expected-derived state or memory injection.
scenario.unitScope: Conditional application ending entry, both winner outcomes, replay Yes/No, muted transitions, explicit Restart distinction, quit-without-ending-song, and unsupported-effect diagnostics.
scenario.browserScope: Actual title -> difficulty -> office -> five bank round trips -> tied winning ending -> both pictures -> replay -> Yes/new campaign or No/credits. Real persistent Tandy requests/status/sample output; existing speaker adapter shares the same dispatched source words.
scenario.negativeControl: Suppress replay sound emission and require the request checker to reject it.
scenario.comparison: Exact request order, guards, choice transitions, reset placement, no phantom title start, and native acknowledgement continuity. Existing deterministic ending/credits and original PNG checks remain required.

artifacts: Local browser screenshots .local/browser-results/ending-audio-yes.png and ending-audio-no.png; original artifacts required by related evidence remain local.

receipts.scope: Run-specific port acceptance outputs; not original full ending/audio captures or replay inputs.
